E2.name: EXTREME_BASIS_DISLOCATION
E2.reason: median dislocation 23.5bp at z<=-8 (2.08x cost) and 7.1bp for SHORT at z>=+8 (0.63x cost); full normalisation would not clear the cost-first screen, and the most extreme thresholds fail the sample floor

candidates.hypothesis: a 10 sigma 15 minute fall with open interest simultaneously contracting is forced position closing rather than information; price normalises once the forced selling ends

verdict_rules.rule: OOS VIP0_BASE net mean > 0 and 95% CI lower bound > 0
OOS trades >= 100, all 5 years present, judgeable folds >= 6 (fold trades >= 10)
judgeable folds: gross>0 in >= 2/3, net>0 in >= 1/2
no single trade > 20% of total net sum
